name: Omoi o Sasageru Otome no Melody ~Afureru Omoi o Shirabe ni Nosete~
original_name: 想いを捧げる乙女のメロディー ～あふれる想いを調べにのせて～
source:
This is the fandisc for Otomelo, with after stories for all the heroines. There’ll be guest appearances from other characters in the similar music-themed Otokana series.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
